title: Sample writing
description: How text, an image, and code sit in a post.

blocks.text: This is not a real essay. It is a stand-in, so the name stays put and the body starts where Today starts.
A plain paragraph first, with the same line height as the home page. Then a figure, then code. The point is to see how they sit in this column.

blocks.alt: Three steps from a request, through a service, to a record.
blocks.caption: A request reaches a service, and the service writes a record. The figure stays inside the column.

blocks.text: A short Java fragment. Keywords sit a little apart from the prose, and the block is one step darker than the page.
Prose continues under the code. A long line wraps. The block scrolls sideways. The two do not mix.

blocks.alt: Three stack frames stacked on top of each other.
blocks.caption: A second, narrower diagram. The caption sits directly under the figure, in the body color.

blocks.text: That is the end of the sample. The name scrolls away with the page.
